summary: Made the release package byte-reproducible and documented the release build, meeting Phase 7 acceptance criterion 5. Root cause: MSBuild's ZipDirectory task enumerated artifacts/staging in filesystem order and stamped every entry with the source file's modification time, so consecutive ./build.sh package runs produced the same 7 entries with different SHA-256. Fix: the PackagePlugin MSBuild target now only stages the exact release files (ArrTags.dll, ArrTags.deps.json, build.yaml, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md, licenses/) into artifacts/staging, and ./build.sh package invokes a new deterministic packer, scripts/pack-release.cs (a .NET 10 file-based app; not part of ArrTags.slnx and adding no plugin runtime dependency), which writes entries in ordinal order of their forward-slash relative path and stamps each with one fixed ZIP timestamp (2000-01-01 00:00:00), using the pinned SDK's deterministic deflate. Two further git-derived SDK inputs were found by isolation and suppressed so a git working tree matches a .git-less clean export: the SDK appended the checkout commit id to AssemblyInformationalVersion (Directory.Build.props IncludeSourceRevisionInInformationalVersion=false) and generated a git-derived *.sourcelink.json fed to the compiler (SuppressImplicitGitSourceLink=true), and the absolute PDB path was embedded in the assembly (src/ArrTags/ArrTags.csproj PathMap maps the project dir to /_/ArrTags). Reproducibility proof: two independent clean exports (526 files each, no .git/bin/obj/artifacts, different absolute paths) plus a third run in the first export after wiping its build outputs all produced the identical artifacts/ArrTags_0.1.0.0.zip, SHA-256 bd10b9b6bf5d31049082d27625b18ba127eb6e2860a454fe2d3c35ccebaaee51, 567,856 bytes, 7 entries; the repository working tree (with .git) produced the same bytes (cmp identical). Documented the pinned toolchain/inputs, the ADR-013 supported version ranges (Jellyfin 12.0.0/targetAbi 12.0.0.0/net10.0; Sonarr 3.x-4.x; Radarr 3.x-6.x on /api/v3), the exact commands, the clean-checkout procedure, the artifact identity with per-entry SHA-256, verification steps, and a release checklist in the new docs/release/build-and-release.md, and updated PLANS.md (task 7.5 checkbox/status, Project Status, Milestone 7 row, Phase 7 acceptance criterion 5), docs/changelog.md, README.md, and docs/implementation-readiness.md. Build 0 warnings / 0 errors; default suite Failed 0, Passed 1218, Skipped 60, Total 1278; host-guarded suite (ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR=/tmp/jf/jellyfin) Failed 0, Passed 1234, Skipped 44, Total 1278 - both exactly equal to the task 7.8/7.4 baseline because no product test was added or changed. No product behavior changed; no plugin dependency was added.

Root-cause isolation: dotnet build -v:diag showed EnableSourceLink=true and a generated obj/Release/net10.0/ArrTags.sourcelink.json containing the repository URL and commit id 5a7372b4e1bb26d628f08e36af085a4fb3d8ad4a, and the DLL strings contained '0.1.0.0+5a7372b4...' and the absolute PDB path; after IncludeSourceRevisionInInformationalVersion=false, SuppressImplicitGitSourceLink=true, and PathMap=/_/ArrTags the DLL contains '0.1.0.0' and '/_/ArrTags/obj/Release/net10.0/ArrTags.pdb' and no sourcelink.json is generated.

Documented clean-export commands verified in this environment: git archive HEAD | tar -x -C <dir> (525 tracked files at HEAD) and git ls-files | tar -T - -cf - | tar -x -C <dir> (525 files) both extract successfully.

git status and git diff inspected: only Directory.Build.props, build.sh, src/ArrTags/ArrTags.csproj, PLANS.md, README.md, docs/changelog.md, docs/implementation-readiness.md, the new docs/release/build-and-release.md, the new scripts/pack-release.cs, and this report changed; no unrelated files and no stray build outputs (artifacts/ contains only ArrTags_0.1.0.0.zip; artifacts/staging is removed by build.sh).
known_limitations: No automated test guards byte-reproducibility. The existing PluginPackagingTests PackagedPluginFact facts assert package contents (required entries, no duplicate SkiaSharp runtime) but not archive byte-identity; byte-reproducibility is verified by running ./build.sh package twice from clean state and comparing SHA-256. A future change to scripts/pack-release.cs or the build properties could regress byte-identity without failing the suite.

Byte-identity is demonstrated with the pinned toolchain in this environment (.NET SDK 10.0.401, global.json pins 10.0.0 with latestMinor roll-forward). A different .NET SDK version could in principle produce different compiler or deflate output, so byte-identity is guaranteed for the pinned SDK, not for arbitrary SDK versions.

dotnet build src/ArrTags/ArrTags.csproj -p:PackagePlugin=true alone now stages files into artifacts/staging and no longer writes the archive; the archive is written by ./build.sh package. build.sh is the only caller of the flag in the repository, and the release doc records the new split, but an external caller that invoked the MSBuild flag directly would now need to run ./build.sh package.

IncludeSourceRevisionInInformationalVersion=false and SuppressImplicitGitSourceLink=true are deliberate reproducibility trade-offs: the shipped ArrTags.dll AssemblyInformationalVersion is '0.1.0.0' without the checkout commit id and the PDB carries no SourceLink mapping. This changes no runtime behavior (Jellyfin reads the plugin version from build.yaml/meta.json, and AssemblyVersion/FileVersion are unchanged) but it does change the assembly's debug metadata relative to the previous package.

The clean-checkout evidence used git ls-files (tracked working-tree content) rather than git archive HEAD, because this task's changes are uncommitted at worker time; git archive HEAD currently excludes the new scripts/pack-release.cs. After the orchestrator commits, git archive HEAD will include the same tracked files and produce the same clean tree.

This task did not re-run the live host end-to-end install/load/render verification; that is task 7.8's evidence against the immediately preceding package (568,004 bytes). The current package (567,856 bytes) differs from the 7.8-verified package only in assembly debug metadata (informational version without the commit, normalized PDB path, no sourcelink) and zip layout; no product code changed and the host-guarded suite (which exercises the pinned 12.0.0 assemblies and the real ImageController/ImageProcessor paths in-process) passes 1234/44/1278. The live host was left clean and running with no ArrTags plugin installed, unchanged from the state task 7.8 left it in.
